fullUnitComponentCoreScene.source: npm test final aggregate run; npm run typecheck and npm run build passed

verifiedCoverage: Completed autosave archives once across repeated reloads; legacy completed one-shell save retains adjacent-allowed rules.
Results expose replay, favorite and actual JSON download; main history supports import, filters, pagination, replay and export.
Historical playback/import/orbit/modal navigation and mobile return leave ongoing live save byte-for-byte unchanged; mocked AI not invoked during historical browsing.
Invalid JSON and same-ID conflicting backup are rejected atomically; oversized file rejected before file read in component test.
52 recent imports retain 50 nonfavorites plus protected older favorite; export includes all retained records.
Simulated history quota failure preserves persisted favorite records, exposes pending completion and export, and retry stores it without duplicate.
Failed favorite write does not show optimistic success; storage event refresh reads another tab favorite and duplicate import preserves it.
Corrupt history is never overwritten by recovery/import, while current pending completion remains exportable.
Replay starts with prefix-only unknown target board and own intact fleet; sunk models appear only at executed sink events; perspective health follows selected frame.
5-shell completed fixture has 32 executed events and terminal 2/5 volley; replay contains exactly 33 steps including deployment and no unused plan-tail shots.
Step, seek, jump, play, speed, restart, modal pause and exit tested; scene is read-only and camera orbit does not advance live game.
Desktop/mobile history and replay rendered and inspected; controls fit 390px viewport with no horizontal overflow.

All 13 prior browser regressions passed, including full normal-UI firing match, save/resume, AI duplicate protection, classic placement, rapid hull selection, move/rotate, orbit, 1/3/5-shell markers and responsive rosters.
evidenceLimitations: New completed history fixtures are generated deterministically for integration coverage; they are not evidence of human gameplay strategy or AI difficulty.
The baseline full-match browser case reads its test save to choose known target cells; mechanics/normal controls are tested, not fair human-play performance.
Storage fault tests inject a localStorage write exception; browser restart, disk failure and cross-device synchronization are outside this local-only design.
Favorites are protected from app retention, not browser data clearing or device loss; UI communicates local storage limits and backup need.
No target GPU or real-phone frame rate validation. Current production Site smoke awaits deployment.

performanceSample.caveat: Headless Chromium with SwiftShader software rendering; not target-GPU performance or a smoothness guarantee.
